markdown.blank-lines.summary: Requires blank separation before top-level headings, lists and fenced code blocks when preceding content exists.

markdown.doc-id-unique.summary: Reports duplicate document IDs from the documentation index across the selected Markdown files.

markdown.document-identifier.summary: Checks configured frontmatter identifier fields for presence, format, uniqueness and optional filename agreement.

parameters.identifiers: Nonempty list of identifier specifications. Fields: field (required), name, paths, required, pattern, format-label, unique, match-filename.

markdown.document-structure.summary: Checks required frontmatter fields and level-two headings for configured document path groups.

parameters.types: Nonempty list of document groups. Fields: paths, required-fields, required-headings, any-headings, alternative-message. Headings are level two.

markdown.fence-closed.summary: Reports fenced code blocks with no matching closing fence.

markdown.fence-language.summary: Requires a language label on fenced code blocks; use text for plain text examples.

markdown.final-newline.summary: Requires exactly one final newline and provides a safe fix.

markdown.formatting.summary: Combines unclosed code-fence and trailing-whitespace checks.

parameters.allow-hard-breaks: Permit exactly two trailing spaces as Markdown hard breaks; false rejects them.

markdown.frontmatter-valid.summary: Reports invalid YAML in the initial frontmatter block.

markdown.heading-duplicates.summary: Reports duplicate sibling headings within the same heading hierarchy.

markdown.heading-order.summary: Reports skipped heading levels, such as H2 followed by H4.

markdown.html-policy.summary: Reports raw HTML tags outside the configured tag allowlist.

parameters.allow: HTML tag names permitted in raw HTML; empty rejects all tags.

markdown.image-alt.summary: Requires image alt text unless the destination is explicitly allowed as decorative.

parameters.allow: Image destinations permitted to omit alt text as explicitly decorative.

markdown.line-length.summary: Reports prose lines over the character limit, excluding code, table rows and lines containing URLs.

parameters.max: Maximum character count for a prose line; must be positive.

markdown.link-relocation.summary: Finds moved local Markdown targets and suggests reviewed link repairs using a shared documentation index.

parameters.moves: Mapping of old local document paths to their new paths, used for explicit relocation candidates.

markdown.link-text.summary: Requires descriptive link labels and rejects empty labels and click here.

markdown.list-style.summary: Checks the unordered-list marker and nested indentation against the configured convention.

parameters.allow: The first one-character entry selects the unordered-list marker; empty uses a hyphen.
parameters.indent: Nested unordered-list indentation in spaces; must be between 1 and 8.

markdown.local-links.summary: Checks local link destinations and anchors, with document-root boundaries and an optional directory allowance.

parameters.allow-directories: Allow directory destinations in local links; false by default.

markdown.ordered-list.summary: Checks ordered-list numbering against sequential, all-one, or either convention.

parameters.style: Ordered numbering convention: one, ordered, or one-or-ordered.

markdown.reference-definitions.summary: Reports duplicate reference-link definitions and missing definitions for explicit reference uses.

markdown.required-heading.summary: Requires a heading with exactly the configured text and level in every selected document.

parameters.heading: Exact text of the required heading; must be nonempty.

markdown.single-title.summary: Requires one H1 title, or accepts a frontmatter title when configured.

parameters.frontmatter-title: Accept frontmatter containing a title field instead of requiring an H1.

markdown.trailing-whitespace.summary: Reports trailing spaces or tabs outside code and provides a safe removal fix; two-space hard breaks are permitted by default.

parameters.allow-hard-breaks: Permit exactly two trailing spaces as Markdown hard breaks; false rejects them.

text.no-dashes.summary: Rejects hyphens and Unicode dashes in prose while excluding code and URLs.

parameters.scope: Prose by default; heading restricts findings to headings. Code and URL destinations are excluded.

text.no-load-bearing.summary: Reports load bearing and dash-separated variants in prose.

parameters.scope: Prose by default; heading restricts findings to headings. Code and URL destinations are excluded.

text.repeated-word.summary: Reports adjacent repeated words in prose, compared without case sensitivity.

parameters.allow: Explicit exceptions, compared without case sensitivity where the check operates on prose.
parameters.scope: Prose by default; heading restricts findings to headings. Code and URL destinations are excluded.

text.spelling.summary: Rejects words outside the supplied offline dictionary and explicit allowlist for the declared language.

parameters.allow: Explicit exceptions, compared without case sensitivity where the check operates on prose.
parameters.dictionary: Exact approved word forms as a string list; no dictionary fallback. Required for text.spelling; an alternative to dictionary-file for STE100.
parameters.language: Nonempty language label for the supplied spelling vocabulary; does not download a dictionary.
parameters.scope: Prose by default; heading restricts findings to headings. Code and URL destinations are excluded.

text.ste100.dictionary.summary: Rejects prose words outside the supplied approved vocabulary, explicit forms and complete technical terms; rejected alternatives remain suggestions.

parameters.dictionary: Exact approved word forms as a string list; no dictionary fallback. Required for text.spelling; an alternative to dictionary-file for STE100.
parameters.dictionary-file: Literal YAML dictionary path relative to the lint root. Accepts words, entries with forms/metadata, technical-terms and alternatives.
parameters.scope: Prose by default; heading restricts findings to headings. Code and URL destinations are excluded.
parameters.technical-terms: Complete approved technical phrases; individual words are not approved outside the phrase.

text.ste100.dictionary.notes: See [STE100 vocabulary and grammar](../ste100.md) for explicit inflections, alternatives, technical phrases and semantic limitations.

text.ste100.grammar.summary: Checks a configurable lexical sentence limit and named forbidden grammar patterns.

parameters.forbidden-patterns: Mapping of diagnostic names to Go regular expressions. Patterns must not match empty text; an empty mapping disables pattern checks.
parameters.max-sentence-words: Positive lexical word limit per sentence; default 25. This is a configurable heuristic, not complete standard word counting.
parameters.scope: Prose by default; heading restricts findings to headings. Code and URL destinations are excluded.

text.ste100.grammar.notes: See [STE100 vocabulary and grammar](../ste100.md) for explicit inflections, alternatives, technical phrases and semantic limitations.

text.strunk-white.correlative-pairs.summary: Flags finite mismatched pair constructions: both/or, either/and and neither/or; invites editorial review.

parameters.allow: Explicit exceptions, compared without case sensitivity where the check operates on prose.
parameters.scope: Prose by default; heading restricts findings to headings. Code and URL destinations are excluded.

text.strunk-white.correlative-pairs.notes: This is a finite editorial signal, not a general grammar parser. See [Strunk and White](../strunk-white.md) for covered patterns and legitimate exceptions.

text.strunk-white.exclamations.summary: Flags exclamation marks in prose for editorial review.

text.terminology.summary: Reports configured disfavored words or phrases and suggests the preferred terminology without automatically rewriting.

parameters.allow: Explicit exceptions, compared without case sensitivity where the check operates on prose.
parameters.scope: Prose by default; heading restricts findings to headings. Code and URL destinations are excluded.
parameters.terms: Nonempty mapping of disfavored words or phrases to preferred wording.
